desc: 亚麻灰绿硬光台座、双头结构微距、扇形留空色块位与三步线性示意的眉笔套图
name: 双头自然毛流眉形勾勒眉笔款

shots.intent: 搜索列表一眼点击，双头笔身完整侧卧入镜、无文案无道具

shots.intent: 用三格同尺寸眉部局部方形面板点出稀、乱、细三类真实困扰

shots.intent: 以削尖肩口与芯体端面的结构证明可用形态，不给任何断言

shots.intent: 只入眉与上颊的落笔瞬间完成代入，不出现可辨识面容

style.backgroundSystem: flat matte sage-grey seamless #D6D9CF for the standing screens, matte ash-white card planes #EEF0EC for the infographic screens, one deep-pine block #27352F for the pain screen and the closing screen; every section change is cut by an oblique 8-degree band; no gradients, no scenery, no tiled grid and no graph-paper surfaces
style.iconSystem: thin single-weight line-art brow schematics, rectangular cropped photo panels, hairline olive leader lines ending in blank key chips, hollow square step markers and one hairline radial fan guide; no circular magnifier viewports, no numbered circles, no curved connector arcs, no hollow swatch rings, no seal rings, no palette-knife strokes, no filled pictograms
style.lightingSystem: neutral 5000-5200K studio light entering as a single firmer key from the upper right so each screen keeps one crisp long cast shadow, balanced by a large bounce fill on the shadow side, one controlled specular on the metal ferrule only, no flare
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent neutral architectural brow-makeup ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of sage-grey seamless field #D6D9CF, ash-white card #EEF0EC, deep-pine ink #27352F used for type and for one matte riser block, and one dry olive accent #7D8C60; neutral 5000-5200K studio light entering as a single firmer key from the upper right so each screen keeps one crisp long cast shadow, balanced by a large bounce fill on the shadow side, with one controlled specular on the metal ferrule only and no flare; backgrounds stay flat matte #D6D9CF seamless, #EEF0EC card planes or the #27352F block, sectioned by oblique 8-degree cut bands, never scenery, never gradients, never tiled grid or graph-paper surfaces; infographic components limited to rectangular cropped photo panels, hairline olive leader lines ending in blank key chips, hollow square step markers, one hairline radial fan guide and thin single-weight line-art brow schematics; one condensed grotesque family for every heading, sub-label and label line, Chinese copy always set as 「」-bracketed at heading 30-36pt, sub-label 16-20pt, label 13-14pt with wide-tracked uppercase secondary labels and no dense body text; the product keeps one identical slim barrel diameter, length and end-to-end proportion on every screen; all human imagery is a generic brow-and-upper-cheek crop or a relaxed hand only with no readable identity, hands relaxed and anatomically correct, real pore texture never smoothed; every colour well and patch stays an empty placeholder supplied only by the injected reference product; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no shade numbers or shade names, no invented weights, durations, wear-time, water-resistance, test data or certificates.
noDrift: no colour palette changes and no warm rose, wine or cool violet cast
no mixed fonts and no dense body text
no random backgrounds, scenery, gradients, tiled grids or shadowless flat panels
no shade numbers, shade names or colour-family wording anywhere on screen
no invented weights, volumes, durations, wear-time, water-resistance, test data or certificates
no identifiable face, full portrait or readable likeness in any brow image
style.presentationRules: the product holds one identical slim barrel diameter, length and end-to-end proportion on every screen; setting the cap aside and leaning the unit on the riser block are the only staging moves; all human imagery is a generic brow-and-upper-cheek crop or a relaxed hand only, with no eyes toward camera and no readable identity; real pore and hair texture kept and never smoothed; every colour well stays an empty placeholder tone supplied by the injected reference and is never numbered, named or pre-tinted
style.surfaceSystem: matte sage-grey seamless paper #D6D9CF, matte ash-white card #EEF0EC and one matte deep-pine lacquer riser block #27352F used as a leaner and as a plinth; no marble, no wood plank, no fabric drape, no pigment smear, no paper texture
style.typography: one condensed grotesque display family for every heading, sub-label and label line; Chinese copy always set as 「」-bracketed; heading 30-36pt, sub-label 16-20pt, label 13-14pt, secondary labels wide-tracked in uppercase; no dense body text, no serif or handwritten mixing
